explication: Marko is a declarative, HTML-based language for building reactive web interfaces. A principal workflow is authoring a Marko template, parsing and compiling it through the compiler and translator, then rendering output through HTML or DOM runtime code. The repository also contains the class-based component runtime, including virtual-DOM support and legacy compatibility. The graph highlights those product stages and documented capabilities; source excerpts are incomplete, so some runtime connections are omitted rather than assumed.
